rows.grounds: compound describing the power's manifold manifestation

items.question: How can the supreme power remain singular while manifesting in many divisions?
premises: The supreme power is one alone.
This same power manifests in many divisions.
Singularity and manifold manifestation are attributed to the same power.
items.inference: The supreme power is singular in essence yet expresses itself through multiple divisions.
items.plain_english: The supreme power is one alone, yet she manifests in many divisions.
